extra.name: Asteroids
extra.blurb: Vector-arcade Asteroids. Keyboard-only originally; playable here with on-screen controls.
extra.author: Doug McInnes

review.pitch: Rotate and thrust a small triangular ship through drifting vector rocks, shooting them apart while dodging fragments in a faithful, stripped-down arcade loop.

extra.name: GRIDX
extra.blurb: Neon twin-stick shooter on a curved grid. Survive the waves and take down each boss.
extra.author: jarvis-llm-codec

review.pitch: Auto-firing twin-stick action on a curved neon grid, with a boss countdown, sub-weapon ultimates and swappable weapons adding some tactical variety.

extra.name: Iridium Reach
extra.blurb: Dogfight from the cockpit of a starship among asteroids and stations.
extra.author: jason-c-dev

review.pitch: Pilot a starship cockpit with a radar display and HUD readouts, hunting enemies through asteroid fields and around space stations beneath a nebula sky.

extra.name: Sands of the Restless
extra.blurb: Hold off waves of the risen dead in a desert necropolis with seven weapons and a buy menu.
extra.author: eddiebelaval

review.pitch: Survive escalating waves of undead in a desert tomb, earning cash to buy and swap between seven weapons, grenades and a special ability.

extra.name: HELLGRID
extra.blurb: Retro first-person shooter: fight through three sectors to close the rift. Every texture and sound is made in code.
extra.author: markcastle

review.pitch: Fight through three reactor sectors in a first-person shooter, with textures and sound all generated in code, until the rift gate opens.

extra.name: Starfall Scavenger
extra.blurb: Neon survivors-style roguelite: auto-fire, pick upgrades, beat the bosses across four acts.
extra.author: Hanazar-Games

review.pitch: Drift through a neon debris field with auto-firing weapons, collecting upgrades and fighting bosses across four acts in short roguelite runs.

extra.name: Neon Vanguard
extra.blurb: Retro vertical shoot-'em-up: steer your ship, auto-fire and clear the waves.
extra.author: alliterhorst

review.pitch: Steer a small ship through a starfield, auto-firing at diamond-shaped enemies while chasing a score, though the screenshots show little variety yet.

extra.name: LLM Chess Arena
extra.blurb: Play chess against your own AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) and read why it makes every move.
extra.author: llm-chess-arena

review.pitch: Play a standard chess game against an AI opponent and read its written reasoning for each move, which turns every game into a lesson.

extra.name: Frankie Poker
extra.blurb: Texas Hold'em against AI opponents powered by your own model key. Play chips only.
extra.author: SonghaiFan

review.pitch: Sit down for Texas Hold'em against AI opponents driven by your own model key, playing chips only, with English and Chinese support.

extra.name: AI Overlord
extra.blurb: A space shooter where an AI running in your browser designs every enemy wave and taunts you.
extra.author: oyekamal

review.pitch: An in-browser language model invents each enemy wave's pattern, speed and swarm size, then taunts you while your auto-firing ship dodges.

extra.name: KoboldAI Lite: AI Adventure
extra.blurb: Text adventures where your AI is the game master: bring Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or a free volunteer model.
extra.author: LostRuins

review.pitch: Pick a UI style, then co-write open-ended text adventures with an AI game master that improvises any story, character or scenario you imagine.

extra.name: Twist Drop
extra.blurb: Twist the tower, drop through the gaps, never touch the red.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag to twist a pink tower so a bouncing ball drops through the gaps, smashing platforms in satisfying bursts while avoiding dark slices.

extra.name: Tube Rush
extra.blurb: Race down giant water slides and fly off the edges to cut corners.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer an inflatable tube down twisting water slides against rival animals, bumping opponents and flying off curves to cut corners and climb the placings.

extra.name: Sky Evolve
extra.blurb: Glide as far as you can, then upgrade your plane and go further.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Sling a paper plane off a ramp, steer through gates that add, subtract or multiply, and evolve into an airliner to hit the target.

extra.name: Turf Rush
extra.blurb: Draw loops to claim land. Don't let anyone cut your trail.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Glide out of your turf, draw a loop and close it to claim land, while rivals try to cut your exposed trail.

extra.name: Horde Blast
extra.blurb: Fire your crowd through multiplier gates and flood the enemy base.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Hold to fire a stream of blue fighters through x2 and x3 gates, multiplying your crowd into a swarm that storms the red fortress.

extra.name: Gulp City
extra.blurb: Be the hole. Swallow the city and grow bigger than everyone.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer a growing hole around a toy city, swallowing people, cones and cars to hit each level's size goal before rival holes do.

extra.name: Brick Climb
extra.blurb: Grab bricks of your colour and build the stairs first.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Race rivals across a brick-strewn floor, collecting only your colour to stack and lay as stairs, then climb first to the next level.

extra.name: Shade Shop
extra.blurb: Mix the paint to match the customer's colour exactly.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap red, yellow, blue, white and black drops into a bowl to match a target colour on a 3D object, then spray it.

extra.name: Pose Rush
extra.blurb: Hit the right pose to slip through every wall.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Run down a street, then drag your fighter's limbs into the right pose during slow motion to kick, punch or dodge past obstacles.

extra.name: Marble Dash
extra.blurb: Roll the marble along a sky track without falling off.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Hold to roll a glossy marble down a wooden sky track, steering around red blocks and over boost pads toward the next level.

extra.name: Stretch Dash
extra.blurb: Grow tall or wide through the gates and smash the boss.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer a jelly runner through gates that stretch it taller, shorter, wider or thinner, then spend that size climbing the finish stairs.

extra.name: Dust Descent
extra.blurb: Cliff dive down the canyon and land the flips.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer a first-person mountain bike down a dusty canyon, grabbing boost pads and passing five rivals to take first place.

extra.name: Cube Trek
extra.blurb: Hop through traffic and rivers in a blocky world.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag block pieces onto an 8x8 grid, clearing full rows and columns to free gems or hit score targets across quest levels.

extra.name: Steady Wheels
extra.blurb: Park it perfectly without a scratch.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Hold to drive, slide the wheel to steer along curving roads, collect coins, dodge cones, then reverse into a marked bay without scraping.

extra.name: Bellhop Boss
extra.blurb: Run the front desk, clean the rooms, grow your hotel.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag your bellhop around a pastel hotel, checking in guests and collecting cash to buy new rooms and staff, unlocking themed floors.

extra.name: Sticky Nook
extra.blurb: Peel and place stickers to decorate the cosy room.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag cute stickers from a tray onto faint silhouettes in isometric rooms, gradually restoring a bedroom, kitchen, bathroom and living room.

extra.name: Chilly Chute
extra.blurb: Sled down the snowy chute, dodge and collect.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Swipe to steer a tube-riding sledder down an icy slope, jumping, ducking under limbo bars, and grabbing coins as levels advance.

extra.name: Viral Den
extra.blurb: Film videos, gain followers, upgrade your streamer den.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap to film clips and watch followers climb while cash buys camera, lights, room and gear upgrades that visibly transform your streamer room across levels.

extra.name: Dress Diva
extra.blurb: Pick the outfit that fits the theme and win the runway.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Dress a client to match a theme like Beach Party, then watch her walk the runway and face a rival's score across levels.

extra.name: Cover Clash
extra.blurb: Pop out of cover, take the shot, duck back in.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Hold to pop out of cover and shoot, release to duck before enemy fire lands, across beach and city waves.

extra.name: Latte Jam
extra.blurb: Sort the cups and fill the coffee orders.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap Lego-like trays into four slots so matching cups from a winding belt hop in, clearing orders before the slots jam.

extra.name: Time Knives
extra.blurb: Time slows down. Throw knives at every bad guy.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Hold to freeze time, draw a path of knives across the neon grid, then release to send them through enemies in a combo burst.

extra.name: Kickback
extra.blurb: Ride the recoil upward and win the duel.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap to fire a floating pistol and use its recoil to launch upward, shooting red guns while dodging fire and staying above the floor.

extra.name: Smash Dummy
extra.blurb: Launch the dummy and smash it for points.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag and fling a wooden dummy into swinging wrecking balls and down stairs, racking up damage points toward each level's goal before throws run out.

extra.name: Gulp Garden
extra.blurb: Drag the hole and swallow everything in the garden.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag a hole around a toy-like diorama, swallowing small items to grow and clearing target treats before the timer expires, across themed levels.

extra.name: Glow Keys
extra.blurb: Tap the glowing tiles in time with the music.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap dark tiles as they reach the glow line to play public-domain melodies note by note, with combo-driven Perfect ratings and star-based level progress.

extra.name: Neon Hop
extra.blurb: Bounce the ball on the beat, tile to tile.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer a bouncing ball across tiles in time with a melody, chasing PERFECT center landings, gem pickups, and a personal best.

extra.name: Munch Buddies
extra.blurb: Two cats, two lanes. Catch the food in time with the song.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap left or right as falling snacks reach two cats' mouths, playing a melody note with each catch while avoiding bombs.

extra.name: Color Groove
extra.blurb: Roll the ball along the music road, follow the colours.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer a striped ball down a neon space road, collecting matching-colour orbs that play song notes while dodging others and passing colour-change gates.

extra.name: Cloud Leap
extra.blurb: Leap from cloud to cloud on the beat.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: A ball hops across floating pillars in time with a song, steering around spikes and gaps while collecting stars across levels.

extra.name: Think Twice!
extra.blurb: Tricky puzzles where the obvious answer is wrong.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Short trick puzzles on a notebook page, like popping balloons or flipping a frown, reward lateral thinking, with free hints and three tries per level.

extra.name: Bolt Twist
extra.blurb: Unscrew the bolts in the right order and clear the board.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap colored bolts to unscrew them into matching boxes or a limited tray, planning removal order so plates drop and the tray never fills.

extra.name: Honk Out!
extra.blurb: Get every passenger on the right-coloured bus.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap boxed-in cars in the right order to clear the jam and park them, so queued passengers board matching colours before spots fill.

extra.name: Knit Flow
extra.blurb: Untangle and match the yarn spools.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Pick spools of colored yarn to send around a conveyor that unravels matching stitches from a knitted picture, while managing five limited holding slots.

extra.name: Swarm Streets
extra.blurb: Lead your crowd through the city and swallow every rival.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer a growing swarm through a city, absorbing grey pedestrians and swallowing smaller rival mobs while dodging bigger ones before the timer expires.

extra.name: Paint Glide
extra.blurb: Swipe the ball to paint every tile of the maze.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Swipe a paint ball sliding across a walled maze until it stops, planning routes so every tile ends up painted.

extra.name: Doodle Legs
extra.blurb: Draw the legs, then race up the steps. Redraw anytime.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Sketch any curve to shape your cube's spinning legs, then redraw mid-race so big arcs vault steps and small ones slip under low roofs.

extra.name: Ring Peel
extra.blurb: Hold to fire and peel the tower. Don't hit the guard wall.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Hold to stream balls down a pier, peeling rings off a striped tower while timing shots to dodge the orbiting guard wall.

extra.name: Squad Surge
extra.blurb: Recruit runners, dodge the saws, storm the castle.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer a growing yellow crowd down a sky track, gathering recruits, dodging saws and spinners, then clashing with a boss at the castle.

extra.name: Squish Gate
extra.blurb: Squish the jelly tall or wide to slip through every gate.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag to stretch a wobbly jelly tall or wide so it slips through gates, building snug-fit combos and fever toward a multiplier finish.

extra.name: Flip Agent
extra.blurb: Flip in slow motion and take the shot. Spare the hostages.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Somersault across rooftop gaps in slow motion, aiming a spinning laser sight to tap-shoot masked goons while avoiding hostages, ricochets and explosive barrels.

extra.name: Swirl Tee
extra.blurb: Fold, dye and unfold to match the shirt.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Fold the shirt, squirt dye into each section, then unfold to see how closely the swirl, spotted or striped pattern matches the target.

extra.name: Splitstream
extra.blurb: Stretch into the splits to stay on the sky rails.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag to stretch or squeeze a roller-skater's legs so each skate stays on its rail, collecting gems along winding sunset tracks.

extra.name: Untwine
extra.blurb: Move the plugs until no rope crosses another.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag rope plugs to empty pegs until no strands cross, with a move counter, tangle count and levels adding more ropes.

extra.name: Tiptoe Tower
extra.blurb: Collect heels, step over walls, strut to the top.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer a runner down rooftop lanes, stacking heels while dodging brick walls, splitting across rails, then climbing a rainbow multiplier podium.

extra.name: Slip Links
extra.blurb: Pull the chains free in the right order.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap the topmost chain to slip it off its pegs, untangling overlapping colored links in the right order, with satisfying combo feedback.

extra.name: Shelf Snap
extra.blurb: Drag the groceries onto the right shelves. So satisfying.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag groceries from baskets into matching outlined fridge shelf slots, with each level bringing a new color scheme, more item types and fuller shelves.

extra.name: Slab Up
extra.blurb: Drop each slab right on top. How high can you build?
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap to drop a sliding slab onto the tower; overhang gets sliced off, while perfect drops keep full size and build a combo.

extra.name: Switchback
extra.blurb: Tap to turn and stay on the zigzag path.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap to flip a rolling ball's direction along a narrow zigzag cliff path, collecting gems while the pace steadily quickens.

extra.name: Flip Volt
extra.blurb: Hold to ride and flip. Land it on your wheels.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Throttle a glowing neon bike along a curving light track, backflipping in midair and landing on both wheels to reach each level's finish gate.

extra.name: Ricochet Rex
extra.blurb: Aim, ricochet and take them all down with three bullets.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Line up ricochet shots off walls to take out goons, set off TNT and spare the hostage, all within three bullets per room.

extra.name: Drip Doodle
extra.blurb: Draw a line so the water fills the glass.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Draw ink lines to steer falling water into a glass; the expressive face and confetti reward each clever solution with satisfying feedback.

extra.name: Smooch Roll
extra.blurb: Draw lines so the two balls roll together.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Sketch ink lines that become physical objects so a blue and a pink ball roll into each other, with simple, readable physics puzzles.

extra.name: Core Crusher
extra.blurb: Hold to smash down through the spinning rings. Avoid black.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Hold to smash a ball down a spinning tower of colored rings, dodging black slices, with a fire-streak power-up for risky dives.

extra.name: Girder Go
extra.blurb: Build a bridge on a budget, then watch the truck cross.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Draw road, wood and steel beams across a gap within budget, then press GO and watch stress colors reveal whether your bridge holds.

extra.name: Snip Snack
extra.blurb: Snip the strings and drop the sweet to the sleepy hedgehog.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Swipe to cut ropes so a swinging candy collects stars and lands in a sleepy hedgehog's mouth, with bubbles and cushions added along the way.

extra.name: Fort Fling
extra.blurb: Fling fruit from the slingshot and topple the raccoon forts.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Pull back the slingshot and fling fruit to collapse wood, glass and stone forts, knocking out every raccoon hiding inside before ammo runs out.

extra.name: Bumpy Buggy
extra.blurb: Gas, brake and balance over the hills. Don't flip.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tilt a toy jeep over rolling seeded hills using only gas and brake, chasing distance, coins and fuel while avoiding flips.

extra.name: Skyline Scope
extra.blurb: Scope in from the rooftop, hold your breath, take the shot.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Hold to scope in from a rooftop, steer the crosshair onto the red-capped target among civilians, and release on a steady breath to fire.

extra.name: Rack Attack
extra.blurb: Aim, pull and sink your balls before the rival does.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Aim with a touch, pull back the cue for power, and pocket your balls before a named rival clears theirs.

extra.name: Putt Isles
extra.blurb: Mini golf on floating islands. Beat the rivals to the hole.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag back to aim and putt a ball across floating-island mini-golf courses, racing rival balls to the cup through themed holes.

extra.name: Fling Feud
extra.blurb: Aim and throw. First to knock out the other wins.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag back to set angle and power, then fling an axe at quirky opponents across colorful stages, where headshots deal double damage.

extra.name: Paw Lagoon
extra.blurb: Match fruit with the beach kittens. Rockets, bombs and combos.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Swap fruit on a beach grid to clear goals like strawberries and wooden crates, triggering rockets and bombs while two cartoon kittens cheer.

extra.name: Whisker Stack
extra.blurb: Tap kitten tiles into the tray. Three alike clear.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap cute cat-face tiles into a seven-slot tray, matching three alike to clear them and build combos while a kitten cheers you on.

extra.name: Crackle Pick: Honeycomb Carving Game
extra.blurb: Carve the shape out of the honeycomb before it cracks.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Trace a pin along a pressed-in outline to carve shapes from toffee before the timer ends, while a crack meter punishes straying.

extra.name: Bonk Brawl: Dodgeball Arena
extra.blurb: Dodge, grab and throw. Last bean standing wins.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag your bean around a slick ice rink to dodge incoming balls, scoop one up and throw it to knock out rivals across the court.

extra.name: Swish Street: Basketball Shooting
extra.blurb: Time the meter and sink the shot. Three in a row lights it up.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Hold to charge a vertical meter, release in the green to swish hoops, with streaks, shifting city courts and level progression.

extra.name: Thrill Loop: Roller Coaster Ride
extra.blurb: Hold for speed, let go to brake. Keep every rider on board.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Hold to build speed and release to brake, matching pace to track sections so every rider stays aboard through loops, jumps and hairpins.

extra.name: Oche Ace: Darts Duel
extra.blurb: Aim through the sway and outscore your rival at the oche.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steady a swaying aim on a clean dartboard, release to throw, and trade nine-dart rounds with a rival to see who scores more.

extra.name: Rubber Reach: Climb Puzzle
extra.blurb: Stretch each arm and leg to climb past saws and spikes.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag a cute blob's four stretchy limbs across tiled floors, planning grips to avoid saws, spikes and pits while counting moves toward the exit.

extra.name: Bloop Stack: Block Tower Runner
extra.blurb: Tap to stack blocks under the blob and hop every wall.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap to stack jelly blocks under a sliding blob so it clears rising walls, with perfect clears chaining into a double-point fever.

extra.name: Wand Rush: Magic Element Runner
extra.blurb: Run through fire, frost and spark gates. Match the element to win.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer a pair of wands through fire, frost and spark gates, matching each element to shatter armoured goons in a smooth first-person dash.

extra.name: Coil Pop: Color Sort Puzzle
extra.blurb: Sort the springy coils so every peg holds one colour.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Lift stacked springy coils between pegs, matching colours to fill each peg, with a limited move budget and levels that gain more pegs and colours.

extra.name: Goo Patrol: Spot the Impostor
extra.blurb: Sweep the x-ray lens over the crowd and zap the impostor.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Sweep an x-ray lens over a crowd to reveal slimy goo impostors, then zap them before the limited battery runs out.

extra.name: Sticky Mitts: Draw Line Heist
extra.blurb: Draw the stretchy arm past the lasers and grab the loot.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag a stretchy glove arm across the vault floor, dodging lasers and sleeping or watching bots, to snatch the loot and watch it snap back.

extra.name: Comet Tee: Golf Long Drive
extra.blurb: Time the swing and slingshot the ball around the planets.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Tap to stop a sweeping arrow in the green, then watch your drive sail past trees toward rising distance goals across colorful worlds.

extra.name: Hex Hand: Telekinesis Brawl
extra.blurb: Grab imps and barrels with your magic glove and fling them.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Grab imps and barrels with a telekinetic glove, then fling them into other imps, explosions or the sea across short island stages.

extra.name: Backyard Plop: Bean Bag Toss
extra.blurb: Toss the bean bags in the hole and beat your rival.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag up to flick bean bags at a cornhole board, scoring 3 for the hole and 1 for the board while rival bags knock yours aside.

extra.name: Zip Vault: Neon Maze Dash
extra.blurb: Dash wall to wall up the neon maze before the goo rises.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Swipe to slide a little robot wall to wall through twisting neon mazes, grabbing dots and stars while dodging spikes and rising goo.

extra.name: Fletch: Arrow Dungeon Roguelite
extra.blurb: Move to dodge, stop to shoot. Pick a new skill every room.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag to dodge, stop to auto-fire arrows at the nearest monster, then clear each room and choose one of three skills.

extra.name: Glowkeep: Monster Horde Arena
extra.blurb: Survive the monster horde. Level up and pick your weapons.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Drag a lantern-wielding hero around a growing swarm while auto-fired spells and level-up upgrade picks build a stronger run across themed stages.

extra.name: Noodle Rumble: Snake Battle Arena
extra.blurb: Grow your snake, swallow smaller ones, beat the boss.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Steer a growing jelly noodle through an orb-strewn arena, swallowing smaller snakes and dodging bigger ones until you can eat the boss.

extra.name: Porch Toss: Newspaper Bike Ride
extra.blurb: Ride the route and toss papers right at the mailbox.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Pedal down a suburban street and release at the right moment to toss newspapers into mailboxes, braking for crossing cars and chasing perfect-throw combos.

extra.name: Bolt Out: Ball Drop Puzzle
extra.blurb: Pull the bolts in the right order and fill the jar.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Pull bolts in the right order so coloured balls fall into the jar, while grey balls and bombs add rules that force planning.

extra.name: Blokko: 3D Block Puzzle
extra.blurb: Spin the shape and tap the blocks out in the right order.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Spin a chunky 3D shape and tap arrow cubes out in the right order, since a blocked cube bumps back and costs a heart.

extra.name: Loaf Flip: Food Puzzle
extra.blurb: Flip the stacks so bread ends up on top and bottom.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Swipe food stacks onto neighbours so they flip upside down, folding the whole board into one sandwich with bread at both ends.

extra.name: Letterloom: Anagram Crossword Puzzle
extra.blurb: Swipe the letters to fill the crossword. New puzzle daily.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Swipe around a letter wheel to spell words and fill a crossword grid, with daily puzzles, hints, bonus words and scenic levels.

extra.name: Ridgeline: Peaks Solitaire
extra.blurb: Clear the three peaks one card higher or lower.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Chain cards one rank up or down to clear three peaks, building streaks across color-themed levels, with a daily seeded puzzle.

extra.name: Lantern Pairs: Mahjong Solitaire
extra.blurb: Match free tile pairs and clear the whole stack.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Match free tile pairs across generated layouts, chaining combos for score, with hints, shuffles and undo to rescue stuck boards.

extra.name: Ninefold: Daily Sudoku Puzzle

extra.name: Boop Board: Bubble Popper Fidget Game

review.pitch: Press or swipe across bubbles on squishy rainbow critter boards to pop them all before the sun-clock runs out, with some bubbles puffing back up.

extra.name: Peekaboo Pals: Animal Memory Match
extra.blurb: Flip the cards and find the animal pairs.
extra.author: RIFFCADE

review.pitch: Peek at the animal cards, then flip them to find matching pairs on a table that grows each level, with hearts for mistakes.

extra.name: Froggle: Pond Bubble Pop

review.pitch: Aim Tippy the frog's bubbles to match three colours, drop hanging clusters into the pond, and clear each level's board before running out of shots.

extra.name: Sudsy Lane: Kids Car Wash Game

extra.name: Tip Top: Nail Salon Makeover

extra.author: RIFFCADE

extra.name: Spin Bakes: Cake Decorating Game
